title: Launch orchestra: handoff templates and team rituals for API/Console/Runtime release train
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable 'launch orchestra' play for the API/Console/Runtime release train focused on three outcomes: 1) precise milestone synchronization across PM, Eng, and Design; 2) a templated release-notes pipeline that reduces manual edits and ensures consistent customer messaging; 3) lightweight team rituals and handoff checklists so on-call, SRE, Docs, and GTM know exactly when and how to act. This ticket covers templates, owner RACI, the comm lifecycle (preflight -> embargo -> public), and automation hooks (PR metadata extractor + release-notes generator). We will not implement full CI integration in this ticket; that is a follow-up once templates are validated with two releases.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone synchronization calendar (canonical milestones + owner for each) published in Confluence and linked in the release dashboard
Release-notes template (front-matter metadata + sections) approved by PM, Docs, and Legal and applied to a dry-run release
Handoff ritual checklist (preflight gate, T-48h checkpoint, T-2h go/no-go) adopted by Eng, SRE, Docs, and GTM with assigned owners
Cut criteria matrix enumerated (Gold/Silver/Bronze tiers) with measurable signals defined and test cases for each
Automation spec for PR metadata extractor and draft release-note assembler reviewed and merged as a spec PR (no production code required for this ticket)
updates: 2025-02-12 Aisha Patel: Initial draft created after sync with Runtime PM and Docs. Identified repeated pain-point: release-note churn and misaligned milestone owners.
2025-02-14 Diego Ramos: Feasibility call with Eng leads. Agreed to a two-week validation path before CI work. Eng asked for explicit smoke-test gates for runtime changes.
2025-02-16 Sofia Nguyen (Docs): Proposed release-note template with front-matter keys: component, model-change, customer-impact, migrations, rollback-steps. Added 'short-summary' for GTM hero blurb.

2025-02-18 Liam O'Connor (SRE): Suggested gating signals: synthetic latency p50/p95 thresholds, error budget drain >10% in 24h, and KV cache miss regressions. Recommended a T-2h rollback readiness checkpoint.
2025-02-20 Diego Ramos: Consolidated decision log and published Confluence page (see links). Requested volunteers for first dry-run (api-2025.03b).
decision_log: Adopted 3-tier cut criteria: Gold (no functional regressions, latency within historical baseline +5%), Silver (minor nonblocking regressions, manual mitigation documented), Bronze (experimental/features behind feature-flag, limited rollout only).
Release-notes front-matter will be required on PRs that touch public APIs or Console UX; internal-only infra PRs may use a short-form auto-generated entry.
Automation approach: build a standalone 'release-note assembler' that consumes PR metadata (labels, title, summary) and Docs-provided sections; integration into CI deferred to follow-up ticket.
Handoff rituals standardized: T-72h milestone sync (owners confirm scope), T-48h preflight (smoke test pass/fail), T-2h rollback readiness check, Launch window run-of-show.
